statement_nl: Let f : ℤ → ℝ → ℝ and g : ℤ → ℤ → ℝ be fixed families of real-valued functions. For every integer n with n > 1, every integer k with 0 ≤ k ≤ n - 1, and every real number t with k ≤ n*t < k + 1, one has f(n)(t) ≤ g(n)(k).
